comments.body:
I implemented the optimization in my fork on branch `issue-4176-syntax-word-wrap-opt` and pushed it here:

https://github.com/pavankumar-vh/rich/tree/issue-4176-syntax-word-wrap-opt

The change batches `Syntax._get_syntax()` word-wrap rendering when `line_numbers=False`, so it avoids calling `console.render_lines()` once per source line. I also added a regression test covering the call count, and the syntax test module passes locally.

If someone with PR permissions wants to open the PR from that branch, the fix is ready.
